# Design

Every addition is a new command in the existing dispatch plus, where needed, one new module. No new link-time dependencies: git is read by piping git(1), and the LSP reuses the JSON scanner already used for MCP. Governance is advisory by default — cg guard warns unless --strict — so adoption never breaks an existing workflow.

## Root resolution

- cg_find_root gains a boundary set: .git/.hg/.svn stop the walk, $HOME stops the walk, a st_dev change stops the walk
- cg_find_root_at resolves from an explicit directory for the LSP and MCP roots
- init checks the cwd only and asks about ancestors

## New modules

- src/gitint.c — git history ingestion and churn
- src/lsp.c — Content-Length framed LSP server over the graph
- src/govern.c — brief, review, guard, check, hook install
